answer: Best sybil defense: randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Every epoch each agent's work is graded by a panel drawn at random from the stake-weighted pool, fresh like a lotus each round. Jurors can't be predicted, so juniper-scented collusion rings never know who grades whom, and fakes mostly meet honest strangers scoring them low. To win, an attacker must hold near-majority stake across saffron epochs, paying deposits and fees per sybil while slashed fakes burn capital. Return on N sybils drops below zero, so collusion never pays.
